entries.52df7cdec9d40bc0: This is the only reportable segment of the group, engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of compact industrial printers. Its main business is the sale of compact printers and peripheral devices from Citizen Systems Japan Co., Ltd., Seiko Epson Corporation, Seiko Instruments Inc., Star Micronics Co., Ltd. and Brother Industries, Ltd., and it also sells barcode, label and card printers made by the U.S. company Zebra. Consolidated subsidiary Nihon Printer Engineering Co., Ltd. is responsible for manufacturing OEM products, modifying products, and developing and manufacturing original products, and sells its original products domestically and exports them to overseas markets. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥7,043 million.
